source.publication: 2025 IT-511 Individual Income Tax Booklet (Georgia DOR), with Form 500 and Schedule 1 bound in (PDF pages 41-49)
source.section: Form 500 lines 8-16 (booklet PDF pp.16-17: Line 8 federal AGI, Line 10 Georgia AGI, Line 11 standard deduction, Lines 13-15c, Line 16 'Multiply the amount on Line 15c by 5.19%. Round to nearest dollar.'); Form 500 Schedule 1 page 1 lines 1-14 (PDF p.47); rate cite PDF p.9 What's New; standard deduction cite PDF p.16 Line 11

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 70,000.00 + wages (person 1) 30,000.00 = 100,000.00. Federal taxable income = 100,000.00 - (standard deduction 31,500.00) = 68,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Georgia starts from federal AGI). Both 50: no retirement exclusion. Schedule 1 additions lines 1-5 none, line 6 = 0.00. Schedule 1 line 13 total subtractions = none = 0.00; line 14 net adjustments = 0.00. Form 500 line 8 federal AGI 100,000.00; line 9 = 0.00; line 10 Georgia AGI = 100,000.00 - 0.00 = 100,000.00. Line 11 standard deduction (married joint) 24,000.00 (the filer takes the federal standard deduction, so must take Georgia's); line 13 = 100,000.00 - 24,000.00 = 76,000.00; line 14 dependent exemption 0 dependents = 0.00; line 15a = 76,000.00; line 15b NOL 0.00; line 15c = 76,000.00. Line 16 tax = 5.19% x 76,000.00 = 3,944.4000 = 3,944.40; the form rounds to the nearest dollar and gives 3,944; expected uses the unrounded formula to the cent. Line 17 Low Income Credit: federal AGI is not under 20,000, so none; no other credits; credits 0.00; state income tax = 3,944.40.
